dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare administrative contractors, Medicare beneficiaries, healthcare providers, and suppliers submitting local coverage determination requests.
dimensions.evidence: an individual entitled to benefits under part A or enrolled under part B... a provider of services or supplier

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory 60-day decision timelines for completeness and 1-year timelines for final decisions on coverage requests and reconsiderations.
dimensions.evidence: determine whether such request is a complete request or an incomplete request not later than 60 days after such contractor receives such request

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal appropriations or spending figures are stated, though administrative workloads for contractors would change.
Amends Section 1862(l)(5) of the Social Security Act to create new procedural mandates, public meeting requirements, and agency review processes.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to ensure timely review of local coverage determination requests under the Medicare program.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory procedural requirements taking effect one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This section, and the amendments made by this section, shall apply beginning on the date that is 1 year after the date of the enactment of this section.

missing_information: Estimated administrative costs to Medicare administrative contractors for complying with the new meeting and timeline requirements.
Exact volume of formal LCD requests and reconsiderations processed annually.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes strict federal timeframes for Medicare administrative contractors to review and decide upon local coverage determination (LCD) requests and reconsiderations.
